Different ways of selling

Who We Serve

A growth system tailored to yours, and ready to evolve as you grow. Appointment-based and consultative or quote-driven journeys can serve businesses, consumers, or both.

Built around bookings.

For businesses where customers reserve a time, visit or scheduled service.

Explore appointment-driven businesses →

Examples include

  • Salons & spasHair, beauty, massage and wellness sessions.
  • Medical & dental officesEnquiries, bookings, reminders and rescheduling.
  • Home servicesCleaning, pest control, maintenance and scheduled service visits.
  • Fitness, coaching & lessonsPersonal training, coaching sessions and one-to-one classes.
  • Vehicle careServicing, inspections, detailing and repair appointments.
  • Pet careGrooming, daycare visits and appointment coordination.

Healthcare examples cover administrative scheduling and communication only.

Built around a conversation.

For businesses where customers discuss their needs before choosing a service, proposal or quote.

Explore consultative selling →

Examples include

  • Professional servicesConsultants, accountants, advisers and training providers.
  • B2B suppliersOffice supplies, equipment and wholesale enquiries that lead to a quote.
  • Agencies & creative studiosMarketing, design and digital projects with discovery and proposals.
  • Property & insuranceViewings, needs conversations, quotations and adviser-led decisions.
  • Home improvement projectsRenovations, solar installations and larger jobs needing an assessment and estimate.
  • Events & cateringDate checks, requirements, proposals and booking decisions.

Your team leads advice and decisions, with the context and follow-up kept together.

Some businesses use both journeys. We tailor the agreed configuration to your process; additional custom work and later expansion are scoped separately.

A selection from the platform connection catalogue, with additional AI client examples. This is not every available app or a claim that every connection is enabled in your account. Built-in connections, AI clients via MCP and third-party automation use different setup methods. We confirm supported actions, permissions, plans and any extra costs before setup. Logos identify the services; they do not imply endorsement.

How connections are checked

Start with the job you need done, then confirm the supported connection and direction of data flow. Google Ads and Meta Ads require Ad Manager access and eligible ad accounts; ad spend is separate. The LinkedIn tile refers to Lead Ads. Google Lead Ads is a lead-form connection, distinct from campaign management. Asana uses supported workflow actions and triggers. ChatGPT and Claude connect as external AI clients through LeadConnector MCP, with approved permissions; this is not an embedded ChatGPT or Claude inbox, or an account-specific verification. Calendar sync behaviour varies. Some other apps need third-party connectors or separately scoped custom work.
